# Fedora COPR packages: owner/project followed by the packages it provides.
# The installer enables each project only when one of its packages is missing.
# Better Blur DX is compiled against one KWin release; the COPR rebuilds it after Plasma updates,
# and `plasmonk doctor` warns when the installed build is older than KWin.

atim/starship starship
